paragraphs: Hyman identifies R' Bun in the Jerusalem Talmud with R' Avin or Ravin in the Babylonian Talmud.[^1]

notes.text: Bun and Avin have abbreviated personal titles, retained as R'. Ravin remains a name, not a separately expanded title. The correspondence and Avin-or-Ravin alternatives are Hyman’s source claim, without an authority merge or an independently checked passage.
